knowledge:
- key_parameters: windows=Size of constant-sized windows (e.g., 1000bp) used to divide the genomic region ;; correctGC=Logical indicating whether to correct for GC-content (requires a reference genome) ;; k=Number of mixture components (groups) for clustering ;; EV=Logical indicating whether equal variances are assumed across groups ;; rightLimit/leftLimit=Thresholds to force outlier segmentation scores into the highest or lowest copy number groups ;; nChunkForVcf=Number of chunks to split a large VCF file into for memory-efficient reading ;; VstTest=Logical to calculate Vst statistics for population differentiation
- alternatives: CNVrd=The predecessor package, which is used if entireGene=TRUE is set during segmentation to skip refinement
- when_to_use: When measuring gene copy number from low- or medium-coverage whole-genome sequencing (WGS) data across multiple individuals, identifying tag SNPs/INDELs in linkage disequilibrium with CNVs, or mapping copy number polymorphic regions
- pitfalls: Requires multiple samples to obtain reliable linkage disequilibrium (LD) results ;; For complex loci with high copy numbers, standard EM clustering might fail due to lack of clear clusters, requiring population-specific priors and Bayesian clustering ;; GC-content correction requires a matching reference genome package (e.g., BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19) ;; The first column of the sampleCNV data frame passed to calculateLDSNPandCNV must contain sample names that match those in the VCF file

workflows.name: simple_locus_cnv_and_tagging
workflows.intent: Measure copy number at a simple locus, cluster samples into copy number groups, and identify tagging SNPs/INDELs.
input: BamMXL (directory containing BAM files of mapped reads)
sampleCNV (data frame containing sample names, copy numbers, and population names)
workflows.stages: 1. Define region of interest with a CNVrd2 object ;; 2. Count reads in windows with countReadInWindow ;; 3. Segment samples with segmentSamples ;; 4. Cluster segmentation scores into copy number groups with groupCNVs ;; 5. Plot copy number profiles with plotCNVrd2 ;; 6. Identify tag SNPs/INDELs with calculateLDSNPandCNV
workflows.code:
objectCNVrd2 <- new("CNVrd2", windows = 1000, chr = "chr1",
                    st = 161100001, en = 162100000,
                    dirBamFile = "BamMXL",
                    genes = c(161592986, 161601753),
                    geneNames = "3B")
readCountMatrix <- countReadInWindow(Object = objectCNVrd2, correctGC = TRUE)
resultSegment <- segmentSamples(Object = objectCNVrd2, stdCntMatrix = readCountMatrix)
objectCluster <- new("clusteringCNVs",
                     x = resultSegment$segmentationScores[, 1], k = 4, EV = TRUE)
copynumberGroups <- groupCNVs(Object = objectCluster)
copynumberGroups <- groupCNVs(Object = objectCluster, rightLimit = 1.5)
plotCNVrd2(Object = objectCNVrd2, segmentObject = resultSegment, sampleName = ii)
tagSNPandINDELofMXL <- calculateLDSNPandCNV(sampleCNV = sampleCNV,
                                            vcfFile = vcfFile, cnvColumn = 2,
                                            population = "MXL", popColumn = 3,
                                            nChunkForVcf = 5, chr = "1",
                                            st = 161600001, en = 161611000,
                                            codeSNP= "Three", codeCNV = "ThreeGroup")

workflows.name: complex_locus_bayesian_clustering
workflows.intent: Measure copy number at complex/multiallelic loci across multiple populations using Bayesian clustering with population-specific priors, and identify tag SNPs.
input: ccl3l1data (data frame containing sample names, populations, and pre-calculated segmentation scores)
workflows.stages: 1. Obtain prior information from a single population with clear clusters using groupCNVs ;; 2. Set prior parameters (means, SDs, proportions, distances) ;; 3. Run Bayesian clustering across all populations using groupBayesianCNVs ;; 4. Identify tag SNPs across multiple populations using calculateLDSNPandCNV
workflows.code:
objectClusterEuroCCL3L1 <- new("clusteringCNVs", x = yEuro, k = 5)
europeanCCL3L1Groups <- groupCNVs(Object = objectClusterEuroCCL3L1)
lambda0 <- as.numeric(europeanCCL3L1Groups$m)
sdEM <- as.numeric(europeanCCL3L1Groups$sigma)
pEM <- as.numeric(europeanCCL3L1Groups$p)
sdEM[5] <- sdEM[4]
groupCCL3L1allPops <- groupBayesianCNVs(xData = xData, nGroups = nGroups,
                                        lambda0 = lambda0,
                                        sd0 = sdEM, alpha0 = alpha0,
                                        distanceBetweenGroups = distanceBetweenGroups,
                                        sdOftau = sd,
                                        rightLimit = 4)
tagSNPandINDELofCCL3L1 <- calculateLDSNPandCNV(sampleCNV = ccl3l1data,
                                            vcfFile = vcfFileCCL3L1, cnvColumn = 4,
                                            population = allPops, popColumn = 2,
                                            nChunkForVcf = 5, chr = "17",
                                            st = 34800000, en = 34830000 )

workflows.name: polymorphic_region_detection
workflows.intent: Identify copy number polymorphic regions and define their genomic boundaries.
input: objectCNVrd2 (CNVrd2 object defining the genomic region)
workflows.stages: 1. Identify polymorphic regions using identifyPolymorphicRegion ;; 2. Plot polymorphic regions and define boundaries using plotPolymorphicRegion
workflows.code:
fcgr3PolymorphicRegion <- identifyPolymorphicRegion(Object = objectCNVrd2,
                                                    segmentObject = resultSegment, 
                                                    plotLegend = FALSE)
plotPolymorphicRegion(Object = objectCNVrd2, polymorphicRegionObject = fcgr3PolymorphicRegion,
                      xlim = c(161300000, 161800000), drawThresholds = TRUE,
                      typePlot = "SD")
plotPolymorphicRegion(Object = objectCNVrd2, polymorphicRegionObject = fcgr3PolymorphicRegion,
                      xlim = c(161300000, 161800000), sdThreshold = 0.05, drawThresholds = TRUE,
                      typePlot = "SD")
